description.text: Chinese Language Program is a non-degree program, with the aim to improve international students’ Chinese proficiency and communicative competence. Those who successfully complete the program will be awarded the Certificate of Completion by SDUW. Period of study: one semester or longer, starts in March and September every year.

duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Language Course at Shandong University , Weihai is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 972 USD/per semester ￥ 7000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. SDUW Application Form for Admission to Chinese Language Program 2. Photocopy of passport, including the page of personal information and visa or residence permit. The passport should have a validity of at least 6 months. 3. High school diploma or above or equivalent. If the certificates are not available yet, a pregraduation certificate should be presented to affirm the applicant’s expected graduation date. 4. Official transcripts for all the courses in high-school or above studies 5. CV in Chinese, or English, or Korean 6. Foreigner Physical Examination Form Note: The physical examination form must be fully filled in. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a stamped photograph will be deemed invalid. Please ensure your physical examination result remains valid during your application time as its validity is only 6 months. 7. Electronic Photos Note: The photo should be in the size of 33mm×48mm with white background in JPG format. Scanned copies of developed photos are not acceptable. Two developed photos should be submitted upon registration.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good physical and mental health and possess a valid foreign passport. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit relevant supporting documents at the time of application and entry. 2. For those who were originally Chinese citizens and later became foreign nationals, and those who have acquired a foreign nationality at birth, one or both of the parents are Chinese citizens and have resided in a foreign country, are subject to the regulations as stated in Document No. 12 [2020] of the P.R.C Ministry of Education and applicants must submit relevant supporting documents (Annex 2); 3. Applicants must possess at least a high school diploma or its equivalent.
